selection_inputs: exact top-2048 page membership in the previous four completed decode steps
admission_rule: start from the capacity-truncated K4096 page set; replace its lowest-priority unprotected pages with recurrent pages already resident in HBM; never admit more initially nonresident pages than baseline
priority_rule: protected pages by descending recent-hit count then recency; remaining pages by K4096 score rank

simulation_contract.correction: all exact top-2048 misses are promoted before attention

freeze_note: The rule and thresholds were fixed before any Gate E1 resident-protection replay. Gate E0 traces already being collected were not inspected with this policy before freezing.
